items.text: [HOTFIX 3.04] - Progress-impeding bug
Hi there beautiful people,
Today we’ve got a quick hotfix for a bug that was reported multiple times. The axe will no longer respawn in the sledge hammer’s location, and will always spawn properly.
A wonderful day to all of you!
Hi there wonderful people,

Today we're releasing a new patch that will fix a variety of bugs, and we're adding more autosave slots and a progression % displayed when hovering a save, so that it's a bit easier to manage progression, or missed events/details. The progression % only takes mandatory events in consideration.

notes.title: Here's a rundown of what is fixed in this patch

items.text: Fixed a problem where players could get stuck because of a weird giant doors scaling bug.
Fixed a crash that could occur while navigation in the Key Bind UI. Players will now be able to properly map the arrow keys.
Fixed a bug where the player could enable the stress meter where it was supposed to be disabled.
Fixed a bug where the player could be teleported in the basement when leaving the tunnel under the mirror room.
Added 3 additional auto-save slots.
Added new safety checks that will prevent doors from getting stuck for no apparent reason.
That's it for this patch. Thank you to everyone who contributed with bug reports!
A wonderful day to you all!
Hi there wonderful people!
We've released a patch that fixes a plethora of bugs. Here's a rundown of what this patch fixes:
Made some minor changes in Chapter: Rakan.
Made some minor changes of key items locations.
Fixed a bug that unloaded the room above the garage when in it in Chapter: Dolores.
Fixed a bug that opened all lights in the babyphone clock puzzle.
Fixed a bug where the garage door to basement would both be opened and locked.
Fixed a bug that caused some dialogues to repeat.
Fixed a bug that caused some subtitles to be displayed in english in all languages.
Fixed a bug that caused the compass to spam the player with its respawn notice.
Fixed a bug that could prevent progress in Chapter: Rakan, if the player didn't drop the flashlight after getting attacked by the tar monster in the psychiatric ward.
Removed the cross blocking the door in Chapter: Dolores. It could block the door in some rare circumstances.
Fixed some visual bugs.
Fixed some collisions that could get the player stuck.
Fixed some other various minor bugs.
If you encounter other issues, be sure to report them through the Steam forum or official Discord, and we'll fix them as soon as we can.
Hi there!
We've released a new patch that fixes the following softlocks that could prevent progress. If this happened to you, simply load your game and it should be fixed.
All dynamic items that can respawn will now properly respawn in the storage room.
It is no longer possible to pick up a beer box in the grocery store that cannot be dropped.

If you encounter other issues, be sure to report them through the Steam forum or official Discord, and we'll fix them as soon as we can.

releases.displayName: Development Update — A sneak peek of the upcoming stuff

items.text: Hi there, beautiful people! Hope y'all having a great day! Many of you have been asking to see some more "meaty" news, and for good reasons, so we thought today would be a good time to do that, since we've got some bigger news.
The Big News

The big thing is that we've now got extra hands that'll help us on porting the game on consoles! We are super thrilled to have partnered up with a very talented team that will give us a well needed boost in our productivity, so you guys can enjoy the game as soon as possible.
Release date

The ultimate question that still remains to be answered! We will be releasing on all platforms simultaneously (PC/Xbox One/PS4), and we're currently aiming for a release somewhere around summer 2020! We will give you the exact date as soon as we are all set with every certification process and what not.
Performance

Our last efforts went on the general optimization of the game on many aspects. We’ve managed to cut down the amount of polygons by almost half without affecting the overall integrity of our assets. We went a bit overboard on our visual presentation to a degree were it can affect the performance without giving you any additional candies for the eyes, so we decided to take care of this aspect. Ultimately, more players will be able to enjoy the game without the necessity of having a monster computer.
Engine Upgrade

As part of our optimizations, we also needed to upgrade our engine’s version to 4.24. What does that mean for us? Well some of our work get messed up in the process of migration, so we need to do a complete QA of everything in the game to make sure nothing is broken or behave in an unattended way. Unfortunately, this takes some time out of our planning and this is not something we can mitigate. You can rest assured, we’ve already managed to fix pretty much everything.
The state of Visage

The main content of Visage is pretty much done. What remains to be done is a moderate amount of sounds integration and all that pesky bug fighting and QA. The bigger part of the development is still to be done on consoles. We have to make sure the game is running smoothly on both platforms without sacrificing too much of the visual aspect.
New stuff

Oh *hell* yeah! We surely have done other things other than bug fixing. Here's a sneak peak of the new stuff we've been working on! The images contain some amount of spoiler, so if you want to avoid that, we suggest that you don't look at them, but hey... Who would be able to resist the temptation ;)
Here goes! Thanks for your enthusiasm and tremendous patience about our game! We're trying to make it the best it can be!
Once again, we've fixed a bunch of bugs that have been reported by our awesome community!

notes.title: Here's a short list of what the latest patch fixes

items.text: Players could get stuck in a sequence moving between walls
Staircase going to the attic will now correctly load
New changes that should prevent rare crashes when finishing Chapter: Dolores
It should no longer be possible for A.I. to dissapear during kill sequence, placing players in a bugged state
Fixed some triggers that would load levels in unwanted locations
Fixed a bug where players could break mirrors indefenitely
Cheers!
Hello beautiful people,
Today we're releasing a hotfix that addresses the following issues:
The sledgehammer's hitbox will now be a LOT more consistent. Those who couldn't break things easily with the sledgehammer will now be able to.
We have made some changes to prevent the game from crashing after the final scene.

Some players still experienced an invisible collision when trying to cross the bridge with a cross. It should be fixed, but we have never been able to reproduce the issue. If this happened to you, please let us know if it now work properly for you.
Based on our own testing, and on the bug reports from the community, we believe there should no longer be any bugs that prevents progress.
NOTE: If you are having trouble with invisible frames during the frames puzzle, you will unfortunately need to load an earlier saved game.
A wonderful day to all of you!
Hi there,
We were notified of the following major bugs that prevent progress, and they should be fixed.
Candles burn out in a few seconds.
Crosses could prevent players from opening the door leading to "the cross room"..
We apologize for the frustration this may have caused!
A wonderful day to you all!
Hi there,
Today we're releasing a patch that fixes most of the bugs that might have prevented players from progressing, and fixes some more minor annoying bugs.
There were still some rare occurances where the player would be killed on a ladder. Hopefully, it's really fixed now.
Picking the basement key twice should no longer be possible.
Fixed a problem where placing frames on the walls would cause a bug with their locations.
Fixed multiple bugs associated to placing candles on sockets. (this could prevent players from progressing)
Fixed some lightswitches that would have wrong states.
The crowbar no longer has the ability to fly around, glitching in every possible way.
The player now runs faster in the cemetary ;).
UI should be a lot more responsive now.
We'll keep a keen eye on the bug reports forum and keep and making the game better!

notes.title: Here's a short list of what we've fixed today

items.text: Fixed a bug where Lucy's kill animation would not trigger correctly.
Fixed some animations during random events.
We *nerfed* the camera.
Fixed a bug where you would teleport out of ladders and get killed.
Some gameplay adjustments.
We have also fixed another bug. It might contain some SPOILER, so you might want to skip on reading that one.

Hi there,
Here's a quick release patch. We were notified that Polish and Hungarian did not work correctly in-game.
This fix should enable players to use these languages now.
A wonderful day to all of you!
Good news everyone!
The NEW chapter is now available in Early Access!
Make sure to update the game, and verify that you are on Version 2.0.
To access the NEW chapter, there has to be NO chapter active, so either start a new game, or finish the chapter you are in. Be sure to check areas that were once inaccessible :)!
Have fun everyone! Remember to take breaks to clean your pants.
Hi there wonderful people!

Today we're releasing the moderately big update V1.4. It does NOT contain NEW CONTENT, and is focusing on fixing the vast majority of bugs we've corrected over the last month, and adjust some stability issues.
All items interaction bugs should be fixed
All languages should display correctly all around the application
All (or most) collision bugs should be fixed
Saved states should be a lot more stable

So basically, everything concerning the currently available chapter should be fixed. If you are still experiencing issues, we recommend that you start a new game, and that you report the issue in the forums or on our official Discord server (discord.gg/visage)

notes.title: Why is it taking this long to release the next chapter?

items.text: We'll keep this one short and concise and release a full development update soon.

We knew when we released the Early Access that the upcoming chapter would be the most time consuming chapter, but our anticipations were still lackey. Development-wise, the next chapter is incredibly more challenging on a technical level, and bugs kept on piling up. We are close to what we believe is a polished version on both technical level and gameplay level, but there's still some work to be done.

notes.title: What's left to do, you ask?

items.text: Bug fixing, of course
Many players have been praising the game's sound design, and we believe there's some work to be done still in the upcoming chapter to meet the expectations
Finish some non-story content (achievements, collectibles, and such)

notes.title: When should we expect the next chapter?

items.text: Once again, we apologize for our vagueness. It should be coming soon ;).
A wonderful week to all of you!
Hi there horror fans,
Today we're releasing a very small hotfix that fixes the following major bug:
Major Bug

Korean language displays incorrectly and is un-readable: Since this patch was not planned, we're taking this chance to integrate a small change with the controls that we think many people will enjoy.: Control changes

The drawer will now open/close automatically with a single click: This change with control will be customizable in the next update. We just wanted to put it out there, so we could gather some feedback on it. Many players have been complaining with how slow drawers open or close, and it quickly became a drag to search in them, making players discouraged to actually find items in them (especially in the cage room). We will also do the same with doors (also in the next update). Some players with low DPI have reported the doors opening very slowly, so a single-click door control will also be available.: Let us know if you like the simpler controls for the drawers, and make sure to voice your thoughts on what should be changed/added to the game.: We're deep into the next chapter, and it should be coming quite soon in Early Access ;).: A wonderful day to all of you!
